summary: Iteration 104: Tested Leonardo AI Image Generation Integration for Scormify. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: Leonardo AI button in Editor toolbar (data-testid='leonardo-ai-btn') opens panel with prompt textarea, 6 style presets (Automatico, Cinematico, Ilustracao, Fotografia, Arte Digital, 3D), and generate button. critical_code_review_comments: Backend leonardo_ai.py service correctly implements generate_image, poll_generation, generate_and_wait, and download_image_to_disk functions
Backend routes/leonardo.py has 3 endpoints: POST /leonardo/generate, GET /leonardo/status/{id}, POST /leonardo/save-to-project - all working
Leonardo API key is properly configured in backend .env (LEONARDO_API_KEY=ai-tutor-platform-12)
Frontend LeonardoPanel.jsx has proper data-testid attributes: leonardo-panel, leonardo-prompt-input, leonardo-style-{id}, leonardo-generate-btn, leonardo-results, leonardo-save-{i}
Editor.jsx imports LeonardoPanel and has showLeonardoPanel state (line 313), button with data-testid='leonardo-ai-btn' (line 1347-1354)
MediaConfigPanel.jsx MEDIA_TYPES array includes leonardo option at line 252: { id: 'leonardo', label: 'Leonardo AI', description: 'Imagem premium com Leonardo', icon: Sparkles, color: 'violet' }
Generation uses Phoenix 1.0 model (de7d3faf-762f-48e0-b3b7-9d0ac3a3fcf3) with alchemy enabled for high quality
Polling endpoint has max_wait of 10 seconds per call, frontend polls every 4 seconds up to 30 attempts (2 minutes total)
seed_data_creation: Leonardo generations created during tests (stored in leonardo_generations collection)
